password.recoveryHint: Case and dashes do not matter.
password.useRecovery: Phone not at hand? Use a recovery code
password.useTotp: Use a code from the authenticator app
password.recoveryCodesLeft_one: A recovery code has been used up; {{count}} is left. If you have lost your phone, ask a maintainer to reset your sign-in.
password.recoveryCodesLeft_other: A recovery code has been used up; {{count}} are left. If you have lost your phone, ask a maintainer to reset your sign-in.

errors.network: Could not sign in. Check your connection and try again.
errors.totpInvalid: The code is wrong or has been used. Wait for the app to show the next code and try again.
errors.recoveryInvalid: The recovery code is wrong or has been used.
errors.expired: The sign-in has timed out. Enter your login name and password again.
errors.cannotSignIn: This account cannot sign in any more.

register.title: Register
register.noInvite: You need an invite link to register. Ask a maintainer of the circle for one.
register.invalidInvite: This invite link is invalid or has expired. Ask the person who invited you for a new one.
register.checkError: Could not check the invite. Check your connection and try again.

password.loginNameHint: 3–32 characters: lowercase letters, digits, _ and -. For signing in; other members do not see it.
password.displayNameHint: The name your recommendations are signed with (your main name), which every member sees; up to 64 characters. It must differ from your login name and from other members' names; you can change it later on the "Me" page.
password.totpExplanation: Scan the QR code with an authenticator app (such as Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, Aegis or FreeOTP). Registering on this phone? Use the button below to add it directly, or type in the key. Then enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
password.qrTitle: QR code for the authenticator app
password.openApp: Add to the authenticator app on this device
password.codeHint: The app shows a new 6-digit code every 30 seconds.

errors.loginNameInvalid: A login name has 3–32 characters: lowercase letters, digits, _ and - only.
errors.loginNameTaken: This login name is taken. Choose another one.
errors.displayNameInvalid: Enter a display name: 1 to 64 characters, no control characters.
errors.displayNameIsLoginName: The display name must not be your login name: the login name is for signing in and is not shown to anyone.
errors.nameTaken: This name is taken. Choose another one.
errors.passwordTooLong: The password is too long (at most 128 characters).
errors.passwordIsLoginName: The password must not be the login name.
errors.codeInvalid: The code is wrong. Check that the app has this key, wait for the next code and try again.
errors.enrolmentExpired: The registration timed out (15 minutes). Submit again; you will then scan a new code, and can delete the old entry from the app.
errors.network: Could not submit. Check your connection and try again.

errors.cancelled: The passkey prompt was cancelled or timed out. Try again.
errors.address: Passkeys do not work at this address. Open the app at the address the invite link uses (for local testing: localhost, not 127.0.0.1).
errors.unsupported: This browser or device cannot use passkeys. Use a password and an authenticator app instead.
errors.unavailable: Passkeys are not available on this instance. Use a password and an authenticator app instead.
errors.failed: Something went wrong. Check your connection and try again.

register.loginNameHint: 3 to 32 characters: letters a–z, digits, _ and -. You cannot change it later.
register.displayNameHint: The name your recommendations are signed with (your main name), which every member sees. It must differ from your login name and from other members' names.

errors.invalidLoginName: The login name must have 3 to 32 characters: letters a–z, digits, _ and -.
errors.invalidDisplayName: Enter a display name: 1 to 64 characters, no special control characters.
errors.displayNameIsLoginName: The display name must not be your login name: the login name is for signing in and is not shown to anyone.
errors.nameTaken: This name is taken. Choose another one.
errors.loginNameTaken: This login name is taken. Choose another one.
errors.invalidInvite: This invite link is invalid or has expired. Ask the person who invited you for a new one.
errors.verifyFailed: The passkey could not be verified. Try again.
errors.exists: This device already has a passkey for this account.

errors.failed: Sign-in failed. The passkey may not belong to this instance, or the account is no longer active.

recoveryCodes.title: Save your recovery codes
recoveryCodes.explanation: If you lose your passkey, your phone or the authenticator app, sign in with a recovery code instead. Each code works once. Keep them in a password manager, or print them and keep them somewhere safe.
recoveryCodes.copyError: Could not copy. Select the codes by hand or download them.
recoveryCodes.shownOnce: The codes are shown only now: the server keeps only their hashes and cannot show them again.
recoveryCodes.confirm: I have saved these recovery codes

credentials.title: Ways to sign in
credentials.loadError: Could not load your ways to sign in. Check your connection and try again.
credentials.removed: Removed. You were signed out on your other devices.
credentials.lastCredentialHint: This is your only way to sign in. Add another one before removing it.

password.add: Set up a password and authenticator app
password.changed: Password changed. You were signed out on your other devices.
password.totpReplaced: Authenticator app replaced; codes from the old one no longer work. You were signed out on your other devices.

recovery.title: Recovery codes
recovery.regenerated: New recovery codes saved; the old ones no longer work.
recovery.hint: Generating new codes makes all the old ones invalid.

verify.title: Confirm it is you
verify.explanation: To protect your account, this needs you to confirm it is you once more (valid for 10 minutes).
verify.repeat: Your confirmation has expired. Confirm it is you, then do the last step again.
verify.codeHint: The 6 digits from your authenticator app, or a recovery code (used up).

errors.network: Something went wrong. Check your connection and try again.
errors.codeInvalid: The code is wrong or was used already.
errors.expired: This took too long. Start again.
errors.lastCredential: This is your only way to sign in. Add another one before removing it.
errors.notFound: This way to sign in no longer exists. Reload the page.
errors.noPassword: You have not set up a password.
errors.passwordExists: A password is set up already.
errors.deviceName: A device name has at most 64 characters and no control characters.

recover.title: Recover your account
recover.entry: I only use passkeys and lost them
recover.explanation: Enter your login name and one recovery code; the code is used up. Then set up a new passkey or a password with an authenticator app right away before you get to the map.
recover.enrol: The recovery code is right. Set up a new way to sign in within 15 minutes.
recover.checkPasskeys: You have a new way to sign in, and you were signed out everywhere else. Your earlier passkeys are still listed below: remove any that was on a lost device.

errors.failed: Wrong login name or recovery code.
errors.usePassword: This account has a password: sign in with “password + authenticator app” and use the recovery code in the second step.
errors.expired: The recovery has expired. Start again with another recovery code.

reset.title: Reset your sign-in
reset.invalid: This link is invalid or has expired. Ask a maintainer for a new one.
reset.explanation: Once you set up a new way to sign in, your old passkeys, password, authenticator app and recovery codes stop working, and you are signed out on every device.
